desc: Class rank (tier) chain for generic classes: one row per class tier (325 rows x 20 bytes; 1010-1265 human classes incl. DLC Celestial Hostess/Kunoichi/Sorcerer, 2010-2215 monsters, 9930-9995 unused dummy chains). Gives mastery EXP requirement, next tier id and per-rank stat bonus. A new generic class needs 6 rows here (ids family*10+0..5).

fields.name: id
fields.desc: char.dat id of the class tier this row describes (1010 = Warrior tier 0 "Fighter"); 0 = empty row 0

fields.name: mastery_exp
fields.desc: class-mastery EXP needed for this rank: base x 1,4,16,64,256,4096 (Warrior base 64: 64..262144; Thief 96; Ninja/Samurai 128; Pirate/Sage/Dark Knight 256). Rows 9930-9995 (unused dummy chains) use 100..14400

fields.name: next_id
fields.desc: char.dat id of the next tier (1010->1011 ... 1015->1010 wraps). Asagi 1230.. points to 1237..1242 (no such rows)

fields.name: bonus_HP
fields.desc: permanent stat bonus granted by reaching this class-mastery rank (HP SP ATK DEF INT RES HIT SPD). Pattern follows class aptitudes (Warrior ATK/HP, Magician INT/SP); last tier gives large values (e.g. 24/3/20/12/...)
